draft.title: Variety, warm-up and cool-down
card: Changing the activities, drills or settings in a training program. It can help an athlete stay motivated and can lower the risk of overuse injury, because the same muscles and joints are not stressed in the same way every session.
Light activity before training or competition, which raises heart rate and body temperature and loosens the joints. It prepares the body for harder work and can lower the risk of injury.
Easy activity after training, such as slow jogging or walking, which lets heart rate and breathing settle gradually. It helps the body begin to recover.
Overuse injury comes from repeating the same movement too often without enough variety or rest. A varied program spreads the load across different movements.
draft.remember: Variety keeps training fresh and spreads the load. Warm up to prepare, cool down to recover.

a.q: Which is the main purpose of a warm-up before a training session?
opts: To prepare the body for harder work
To help the body begin recovering
To spread stress across different muscles
To keep an athlete interested in training
a.why: A warm-up raises heart rate and body temperature and loosens the joints, so the body is ready for harder work. Helping the body begin to recover is the job of a cool-down, which comes after training.
a.clue: Think about what the body needs before hard effort.

b.q: Jarrah, a Year 12 runner in Tamworth, runs the same road loop five days a week. After two months he has shin pain and no longer enjoys training. Which change best deals with both problems?
opts: Swap some runs for swimming, cycling and new routes
Run the same loop faster to finish sooner
Skip the cool-down to save time for extra runs
Add a longer warm-up and keep the same routine
b.why: Varying activities and routes spreads the load across different movements, which lowers overuse risk, and it makes training more interesting. A longer warm-up helps prepare the body, but it does not change the repeated stress or the boredom, so it is the more tempting wrong answer.
b.clue: The same movement is repeated every session.

a.best: To prepare the body for harder work

b.best: Swap some runs for swimming, cycling and new routes
